claims: Sixth-seeded Tennessee defeated third-seeded Virginia 79-72 on March 22, 2026.
Tennessee advanced to the NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 for the fourth consecutive season.
Ja'Kobi Gillespie scored 21 points for Tennessee.
Ja'Kobi Gillespie had 6 assists for Tennessee.
Thijs De Ridder scored 22 points for Virginia.
The game was at Xfinity Mobile Arena, Philadelphia, PA.
Tennessee had 1 turnover in the first half.
Virginia took a brief 71-70 lead late in the game.
Tennessee ended on a 9-1 run fueled by free throws.
With 2:12 remaining, a disputed out-of-bounds call was made against Virginia.
The out-of-bounds call was upheld by replay.
Tennessee advances to play 2-seed Iowa State in the Sweet 16.
Tennessee has made the second weekend of the NCAA Tournament for the fourth year in a row under coach Rick Barnes
